summary: Fixes redose reminder scheduling and foreground notification delivery.

minor_improvements: Settings now shows whether notifications are allowed, blocked, or not yet requested.
bug_fixes: Fixed redose reminders not appearing while gTimer is open.
Redose reminders now reschedule from the most recent active dose after missed, edited, deleted, or synced dose changes.
Turning notifications on now requests permission and schedules a reminder for the current latest dose when one is pending.
